WHEREAS:
A. The Lessor is the legal owner of the office building located at Tower B, Commercial and Service Area combined with High-rise Residence at lot 1-13 in Functional Area No. 1- No. 15 Tran Bach Dang Street, Quarter 3, Thu Thiem Ward, Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam (“Building”);
B. The Lessor desires to lease and the Lessee desires to rent from the Lessor certain areas of the Building (“Leased Premises”) for the use of office business according to the terms and conditions below .
The Parties agree to sign this Office lease agreement (“Agreement”) with the following content:
ARTICLE 1. INFORMATION OF THE OFFICE FOR RENT
1. Location:
- Tower B, Commercial and Service Area combined with High-rise Residence at Lot 1-13 in Functional Area No. 1- No. 15 Tran Bach Dang Street, Quarter 3, Thu Thiem Ward, Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam.
- Lot No.: 3
- Map Sheet No.: 66, An Khanh Ward, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City according to Land Use Rights Certificate No. in the certificate issuance book CT79302 issued by the Ho Chi Minh City People's Committee on December 31, 2019
2. Location of the Leased Premises: is part of the office rental area as provided in Schedule 2 (“Net Leased Area”) of the Building with details as specified in Item 5, Schedule 2 hereof.
3. Current quality status of the Leased Premises: as specified in Item 6, Schedule 2 hereof.
4. Area of the Leased Premises:
- Total construction floor area for lease: details as specified in Item 4, Schedule 2 hereof.
- Total land use area: not applicable
5. Usage function: using as the Lessee’s office.
6. Attached equipment of the Leased Premises: as listed in Item 6, Schedule 2 and Schedule 5 hereof.
ARTICLE 2. THE RENT
1. The rent applied to the Leased Premises shall be calculated on a Quarterly/Bi-Quarterly/Year basis corresponding to the Unit Rent Price multiplied by the Net Leased Area (“Rent”) and is calculated from the Rent Commencement Date, in which:
(a) Unit Rent Price is specified in Item 14, Schedule 2 hereof. The Unit Rent Price is inclusive of non-agricultural land use tax and exclusive of the following amounts:
(i) Value added tax;
(ii) Service Charge (as specified in Item 15, Schedule 2);
(iii) Fire and explosion insurance fees for the Leased Premises according to the provisions of the laws and the terms of this Agreement;
(iv) Other costs as stipulated in Article 2.5, 2.6, 2.7, 2.8 and other provisions as specified in this Agreement.
(b) During the Lease Term, the Rent can be adjusted as specified in Schedule 2. The Rent applied to the renewal period will be negotiated by the Parties at the time of proceeding the renewal procedure.
(c)
2. Utility charges such as electricity, water, telephone, internet, telecommunication services and other services payable by the Lessee to the electricity, water, telephone supplier and other supplying agencies. In case the Utility Charge is collected by the Lessor, the payment shall be implemented in accordance with Item 20, Schedule 2 hereof.
3. Booking Deposit, Security Deposit
a. Booking deposit:
Right upon the Offer to Lease being signed, the Lessee shall pay the Lessor a booking deposit (“Booking Deposit”) equivalent to one (01) month of Rent, Service Charge and the corresponding taxes, if any, within seven (07) Business Days. In case the Lessee does not proceed the Agreement signing within thirty (30) days from the day of signing the Offer to Lease, the Lessor is entitled to terminate all negotiations and has the right to introduce new client to the Leased Premises without any compensation and the Booking Deposit shall be forfeilt.
Upon signing this Agreement, the Booking Deposit shall be included in the Security Deposit that the Lessee must pay to the Lessor.
b. Security Deposit:
Within seven (07) Business Days from the signing date of this Agreement, the Lessee shall pay the Lessor the security deposit equivalent to three (03) months of Rent, Service Charge and corresponding taxes, if any (“Security Deposit”).
c. Settlement of the Security Deposit:
(i) The Lessor shall keep the Security Deposit until the Agreement expires, the Lessee hands over the Leased Premises to the Lessor, and fulfill all obligations arising from this Agreement to the Lessor. Upon termination of all obligations and completion of all payments to the Lessor, the Lessee shall have the Security Deposit refunded without interest. The Lessee is not entitled to use this Security Deposit to replace or pay for Rent, Service Charge, corresponding taxes or other payables to the Lessor.
(ii) In the event the Parties agree to change the Rent and Service Charge, the Security Deposit shall be adjusted accordingly.
(iii) The Lessor has the right to deduct the Security Deposit (or part thereof) to pay for any late payment amount of the Lessee, including late payment interest, penalties for violations, compensation for damages. For clarity, the right to deduct the Security Deposit does not affect the Lessor's right to request the Lessee to pay the due amounts. In the event the Lessor makes any deduction from the Security Deposit in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement, then, upon request of the Lessor, within ten (10) days from the date of receiving such request, the Lessee must compensate an amount equivalent to such deduction to ensure that the Security Deposit always corresponds to three (03) months of Rent, Service Charge and corresponding taxes.
(iv) In the event the Lessee does not comply with the request for supplementing the Security Deposit as requested by the Lessor stated in Article 2.3(c)(iii) above, the Lessee must comply with this request within the next ten (10) Business Days from the date of expiry of the time limit mentioned in Article 2.3(c)(iii). In case the Lessee still fails to fulfill this obligation during the above-mentioned time, it shall be considered a violation to the Agreement and the Lessor has the right to unilaterally terminate the Agreement.
4. Service Charge
a. In order to be provided with the Service as listed in Schedule 3, the Lessee is responsible to pay the Service Charge as specified in Item 15, Schedule 2 to the Lessor.
b. The Lessor may, from time to time, in case necessary for operation and maintenance of the Building, have the right to revise the Service Charge by serving a 30 (thirty) days prior written notice (“Service Charge Notice”) to the Lessee. The revised Service Charge shall automatically take effect as from the date specified in the Service Charge Notice until further notice from the Lessor. In case of increment in the Service Charge, the Lessor shall provide the Lessee with reasonable justification and supporting documents (if any) for such increment.
c. Any interruption or temporary stoppage of any of the Service, which is out of the Lessor's reasonable control and will not exceed [3] hours, will not neither be considered a violation or disturbance of Lessee's use and possession of the Leased Premises, nor exempt the Lessee from any obligation hereunder or force the Lessor to be liable for any damage or allow the Lessee to be reduced the Rent, Service Charge. The Lessor must, as soon as practicable, inform the Lessee in advance of such interruption or temporary stoppage exceeds [3] hours and/or when such interruption or temporary stoppage of Service has adverse impact on the Lessee.
d. Unless otherwise provision clearly stated herein, the Lessor shall (i) have exclusive right to choose any supplier to provide the Service for the Leased Premises and the Building, and (ii) have the right, from time to time, to reasonably adjust the standard for such Service, provided that such selection or adjustment will not result in any reduction of the Service's quality.
5. Parking fee
a. During the Lease Term, the Lessee shall jointly use the common parking lots for cars and motorbikes, driveways, and walkways with the Lessor, as well as with lessees of other leased areas and guests of the Lessor or of the Lessees of other leased areas in in accordance with the internal regulations of the Building (“Building Regulations”) specified in Schedule 6 and any other different regulations and rules according to the purpose of use specified by the Lessor or changed from time to time.
b. The number of fixed motorbike parking lots and car parking lot s that the Lessor arranges for the Lessee during the Lease Term and the corresponding parking fees (“Parking Fee”) are specified in Item 22, Schedule 2. Parking Fee is calculated based on the actual number of registrations that the Lessee registers monthly with the Lessor.
c. Parking location will be at the sole discretion of the Lessor from time to time.
d. The Lessor reserves the right to adjust the Parking Fee from time to time. In case of adjustment to the Parking Fee, the Lessor or the representative of the Lessor shall send to the Lessee a written notice thirty (30) days in advance regarding such adjustment.
6. Fee for air-conditioning supply out of Business Hours:
a. In the event the Lessee requires to provide the air-conditioning out of Business Hours, the Lessee is responsible to pay the Lessor fee for air-conditioning supply out of Business Hours (“After-Hours Air-conditioning Fee”) based on the charge as specified in Item 23, Schedule 2.
b. The Lessor reserves the right to adjust the After-Hours Air-conditioning Fee from time to time. In case of adjustment to the After-Hours Air-conditioning Fee, the Lessor or the representative of the Lessor shall send to the Lessee a written notice thirty (30) days in advance regarding such adjustment.
7. Other charges
In the event the Lessee requires the Lessor to provide the service that falls out of the scope of services with respective charges as stated in Article 2.1 to Article 2.7 of this Agreement, the Lessor shall advise the Lessee the charge for such service before providing it. Service provision shall only be performed upon written confirmation from the Lessee.
8. Tax
All payments pertaining to this Agreement are exclusive of Value Added Tax (“VAT”). Except for the Booking Deposit and the Security Deposit, VAT and any other taxes which are now or hereafter levied by any competent authority upon the Rent, Service Charge, Utility Charge and/or payable other amounts will be calculated under the Vietnamese laws and paid by the Lessee simultaneously with the related payable amount.
ARTICLE 3. METHOD AND SCHEDULE OF PAYMENT
1. Payment method: Payments in Vietnamese Dong shall be made by bank transfer into the account designated by the Lessor. Details of the account is specified in item b, clause 3 of this Article or in the written payment instruction sent by the Lessor to the Lessee in case of any changes to the payment account information.
2. Payment schedule:
a. The Rent and Service Chage for the first Payment Period shall be paid by the Lessee to the Lessor within five (05) Business Days before the Commencement Date.. For the following Installations, the Lessor shall send a Payment Request to the Lessee regarding such Quarter/Bi-Quarter/Year, in which clear state the followings:
(i) The Rent payable plus VAT; and
(ii) Service Charge payable plus VAT and the Lessee shall pay according to such Payment Request within five (05) Business Days from the date of the corresponding payment request. The Lessor shall send a valid Invoice to the Lessee within seven (07) days from the date of receiving full payment from the Lessee according to the Payment Request.
b. Regardless of the Payment Request of the Lessor, the Rent, Service Charge and VAT shall be calculated from the Rent Commencement Date (as defined in Item 11, Schedule 2 hereof) and is paid in advance by the Lessee for each Payment Term with payment schedule specified in Point a, Clause 2, Article 3 hereof.
The payment schedule for other related fees specified in the Lease is detailed in the corresponding sections in Schedule 2 of this Agreement.
c. In the event the Payment request specified in Article 3.2(a) is delayed or not received by the Lessee, the Lessee undertakes to pay in full the Rent and the Service Charge of each Payment Term within the first 05 (five) Business Days of such Payment Term.
3. Currency and account for payment
a. All payments indicated herein shall be made in Vietnam Dong by cash or transferred into the Lessor's bank account mentioned in Article 3.3(b) below or other account designated in advance by the Lessor in writing.
b. All payable amounts under this Agreement shall be transferred to the following bank account:
 Bank account name: Khoi Phat Investment One Member Company Limited
 Bank name: Shinhan Bank Viet Nam - HCMC Branch Bank address: Centec Tower, 72-74 Nguyen Thi Minh Khai, Vo Thi Sau Ward, Dist 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam Bank account number: 700 031 076 553 (VND)
 SWIFT code: [SHBKVNXXXX]
4. From the Handover Date, the Lessee must pay utility charge for the use of electricity, water, telecommunications, internet and all other services in the Leased Premises on the basis of actual use provided by relevant suppliers to the Lessee.
5. Penalty interest for late payment
If the Lessee fails to make any payments in due for the Lessor as stipulated in this Agreement (whether or not receiving the Payment request from the Lessor), the Lessee shall pay the Lessor interest on the overdue amount (“Late Payment Interest”). The Late Payment Interest shall be calculated on the following basis:
a. The overdue payment period commencing from the next day after the due date to the date that the Lessor actually receives such payment; and
b. Interest rate shall be [0.05%/day] applied on the overdue amount.
ARTICLE 4. LEASE TERM, TIME OF HANDOVER OF THE LEASED PREMISES AND ATTACHMENTS
1. Lease Term: Lease term of the Leased Premises (“Lease Term”) is [ ] years from the Commencement Date.
2. Time of handover: The Lessor shall hand over the Leased Premises to the Lessee on the Handover Date as specified in Item 8, Schedule 2 of this Agreement and after the Lessee has fulfilled the payment of Security Deposit to the Lessor.
3. Attachments: not applicable.
4. Handover procedure:
a. On the Handover Date, the Lessor shall hand over the Leased Premises to the Lessee. The Lessor shall hand over the Leased Premises in a condition suitable for the intended lease purpose, and shall ensure that the Lessee can use and enjoy the Leased Premises for such intended purpose throughout the Lease Term.When handing over the Leased Premises, the Parties shall sign a minutes on inventory and handover of all fixtures/fittings according to the handover equipment list specified in Schedule 5 hereof (“Handover Equipment List”) belonging to the Leased Premises (“Premises Handover Minutes”). Such Premises Handover Minutes shall be an integral part of this Agreement and attached in Schedule 4. After signing on this Premises Handover Minutes, the Lessee shall officially occupy the Leased Premises.
b. The Lessee shall not arbitrarily re-construct or change the structure or technical systems of the Leased Premises, including external and internal decoration, without the Lessor's prior written consent.
c. Notwithstanding Article 4.6 hereunder, the Lessee shall not arbitrarily construct, re-construct, change or destroy the Leased Premises, including but not limited to external and internal decoration of the Leased Premises, without the Lessor's prior written consent. The construction of such items indicated herein must be followed by the Lessor's regulations.
d. The Lessee must give an immediate notice to the Lessor of any damages or changes at the Leased Premises that may affect the Lessor's property or any remedy and modification of the Leased Premises.
5. Renewal of the Lease
a. The Lessor agrees that the Lessee has the right to request a renewal of this Agreement on the same terms and conditions (except for the Rent, Service Charge, and other approtiate terms) for the renewed lease term being [ ] year from the expiration of the Lease Term (hereinafter referred to as the “Renewal Term”), subject to the Lessee having performed its principal obligations under this Agreement. The Rent payable during the Renewal Term (from time to time) shall be truly based on the prevailing market conditions and subject to appropriate adjustment by the Lessor.
b. At least six (06) months prior to the Expiry Date, the Lessee shall send the Lessor a proposal for renewal of the Lease (“Renewal Proposal”). The Lessor will respond within thirty (30) days of receiving the Renewal Proposal, including the proposed terms and conditions for the renewal of the Lease.
Within fifteen (15) days as of receiving the Lessor's response, the Lessee must send a written response (“Response”) to the Lessor regarding:
(i) agree with the Lessor's proposal, or
(ii) disagree or agree with a part of the Lessor's proposal. Then, the Parties shall negotiate in goodwill for the terms and conditions to renew the Agreement within thirty (30) days from the date the Lessor receives the Response.
c. For avoidance of doubt, the Lessor shall not be obliged to renew the Agreement if:
(i) The Lessees fails to send the Renewal Proposal or the Response to the Lessor in proper timeline indicated in Article 4.5(b) above, or
(ii) The Parties fail to reach a mutual agreement on the terms and conditions in proper timeline indicated in Article 4.5(b) above, or
(iii) The Lessee breaches the Agreement at the time of renewal or any previous time.
d. In the event the Parties agree to renew the Agreement, the Parties shall sign a renewal annex or a new lease agreement under the template required by the Lessor at least one (01) month prior to the Expiry Date.
6. Fitting out for the Leased Premises (“Fit-out Work”)
a. Before commencement of the Lease Term, the Lessee has a period to carry out the Fit-out Work (“Fit-out Period”) specified in Item 10, Schedule 2 of this Agreement.
b. Requirement to the Lessee during the Fit-out Work:
(i) The Lessee is required to deposit a sum mentioned in Item 21, Schedule 2 (“Fit-out Deposit”) five (05) days prior to the commencement of the Fit-Out Work. Such Fit-out Deposit shall be refundable as specified in Article 4.6(f) hereunder.
(ii) The Lessee shall pay the Service Charge as mentioned in Item 15, Schedule 2 for the use of the Service during the Fit-out Period. Furthermore, the Lessee is liable to pay the Utility Charges for the utilities if used at the Leased Premises during Fit-out Period.
(iii) The Lessee ensures that the Fit-Out Work, at the Lessee's own cost and subject to the Lessor's prior approval, is constructed under the design drawing, the fire fighting and fire protection specification approved by the Lessor/competent State Authority, simultaneously in line with the Building Regulations and the Lessor's requirements.
(iv) The Lessee shall not cause any damages or obstructions to adjacent premises in the Building or interfere with the business activity of other lessees. If the fit-out work makes unreasonably noisy, and which may interfere with the Building's operation or other Lessees, it must only be carried on a specific time as reasonably anticipated by the Lessor.
(v) During and/or after finishing the Fit-out Work, the Lessee must remedy any defects or damages arising from the Fit-Out Work as reasonably requested by the Lessor.
(vi) The Lessee and/or its constructor must maintain all necessary insurance contract(s) during the Fit-out Period, including insurance for liability, loss, damage, or injury arising from the acts of omissions of the constructor and/or subconstructor during the Fit-out Period as well as when performing other repairs, upgrades, and installations at the Leased Premises during the Lease Term, including compliance with employer liability and occupational accident regulations compensation for the worker in effect at the time the construction begins. The Lessee shall provide the Lessor with copies of such insurance contract(s) upon request.
c. The Lessee shall pay the Fit-out Deposit and Service Charge during the Fit-out Period in one installation based on the Payment request sent by the Lessor before the commencement date of the Fit-Out Work. The Lessee still pays the Service Charge during the Fit-out Period up to the preceding date of Commencement Date even though the Fit-out Period is finished earlier than estimated.
d. Delay in construction and in completion of all or any part of the Fit-out Work by the Lessee and/or its contractors shall not alter any subsequent time period or constitute a ground for the Lessee's delay in payment of Rent, Service Charge or other payable amounts under this Agreement.
e. The Lessee, with support from the Lessor when necessary, shall obtain and maintain all necessary approvals required by the competent State Authority to carry out the Fit-out Work at the Leased Premises, including approval and finalization of the fire protection system (if any) in accordance with the laws.
f. Within thirty (30) days from the expiry of the Fit-out Period, provided that the Leased Premises is constructed in accordance with the provisions disclosed herein and remedied the defects (if any) satisfying the Lessor's reasonable requirement and fully satisfying the conditions listed in Article 4.6(b),(c),(e) above, the Fit-out Deposit shall be refunded in the amount and currency that the Lessor previously received from the Lessee, without interest.
The Lessor has the right to deduct any part from the Fit-out Deposit to compensate for any damages or loss to the Leased Premises and/or the Building or borne by the Lessor or other Lessees due to the Lessee and/or its contractor's mistakes during the Fit-out Period.
7. Return of the Leased Premises
a. On the date on which this Agreement is terminated in accordance with Article 10.1 herein, the Lessee shall reinstate the Leased Premises back to original status as recorded on the Premises Handover Minutes (unless having otherwise agreement) and return the Leased Premises to the Lessor. After comprehensively inspecting, both Parties shall sign the minutes of acceptance and return the Leased Premises, clearly stating the conditions of equipment and facilities in the Leased Premises at the time of return to the Lessor.
b. In the event the Lessee fails to reinstate and return the Leased Premises to the Lessor as required by Article 4.7(a) hereinabove, the Lessor shall carry out such works and deduct arising costs from the Security Deposit or request the Lessee to reimburse such costs, simultaneously:
(i) The Lessee is considered to be beyond the time limit occupying the Leased Premises, without prejudice to any rights or remedies available to the Lessor, the Lessee shall pay to the Lessor for each day of such holding over with the double amount of prevailing Rent and Service Charge from the termination date of this Agreement to the date when the Leased Premises is properly returned under this Agreement. Such provision shall not be construed as the Lessor's consent for renewal of the Agreement and/or continuously holding over the Leased Premises after the termination date of this Agreement. All payable amountherein must be immediately paid to the Lessor as soon as receiving Lessor's request;
(ii) After twenty (20) days since the termination date of this Agreement, the Lessor has the right to remove the Lessee's property out of the Leased Premises in the witness of a third party. Before removing the Lessee's property out of the Leased Premises, the Lessor shall list out the Lessee's property. The Lessor shall keep such property in its storage for a maximum of thirty (30) days since the date of removing property. The Lessee shall bear all costs and expenses concerning such removal and storage;
(iii) Over thirty (30) days since the date when the Lessor removes the Lessee's property out of the Leased Premises, if the Lessee does not come to take over its property, the Parties shall consider that the Lessee abandons these properties and the Lessor has the right to dispose of (by selling or leasing) such property. If the sum received by the Lessor from the disposal of such property is less than the Lessee's outstanding payments, the Lessee has to pay the Lessor for the deviation upon receipt of written notice from the Lessor. If the sum received by the Lessor from the disposal of such property is more than the Lessee's outstanding payments, the Lessor shall return such exceeded amount to the Lessee.
ARTICLE 5. USE OF THE LEASED PREMISES
1. The intended use of the Leased Premises of the Lessee (“Lease Purpose”): the Leased Premises shall be used as an office to carry out business activities licensed by state agencies of the Lessee in accordance with the laws. In case there are changes in legal regulations related to the Lessee's business activities or the intended use of the Leased Premises and/or the Building affecting the Lease Purpose, the Lessee’s intended use of the Leased Premises will be adjusted accordingly.
2. Limitation to the use of the Leased Premises:
a. The Lessee is not entitled to sublease the Leased Premises to any individual, organization without the Lessor's prior witten consent.
b. The Lessee is not allowed to use the Leased Premises to carry out certain business activities or to organize events that, in the opinion of the Lessor, will cause a nuisance or affect the tranquility of other rental areas in the Building or the Building's Common Area. The Lessor reserves the right to immediately, and without recourse from the Lessee, request the Lessee to immediately cease any unauthorized use or limit such use by the Lessees. Conditions limiting this use include, but are not limited to, holding public auctions, sweepstakes, raffles, celebrations or public presentations or other events which, in the sole opinion of the Lessor, would cause a nuisance or attract crowds or unnecessary attention to the Building.
c. The Lessee shall not erect or display any altar in the Leased Premises that containing fire, including the use of incense or candles.
d. The Lessee shall not load or use the floors, walls, ceilings or structures of the Leased Premises or the Building to deform, damage or otherwise affect structural parts, load-bearing frames, roofs, foundations, beams, and exterior walls of the Building.
e. The Lessee shall not overload floors, elevators, electrical installations or gutters, pipes, sewers, discharge pipes, wires, telephone and telegraph cables, grids, ditches, trenches, ventilation pipes and water pipes (if any) in the Leased Premises and/or the Building.
f. The Lessee shall not do or omit to do anything that is likely to obstruct, or place additional load on, any ventilation, heating, air conditioning or other machinery or equipment serving the Building or the Leased Premises.
g. The Lessee shall not allow anyone to sleep in the Leased Premises or use the Leased Premises for residential purposes, including cooking in any form.
h. The Lessee shall not, at any time, place goods, pallets, empty packaging, waste or any other obstructions in the Common Area and shall only use waste disposal facilities and waste containers designated for such purpose.
i. The Lessee shall not arrange, place or install any objects, goods or other items in front of the Building or any other place outside the Leased Premises.
j. Installation of advertisements and signage
(i) The Lessee must not place or display outside the Leased Premises or the Building or on windows or inside the Leased Premises that is visible from outside the Leased Premises or any other areas within the Bulding any names, documents, notices, signage, light signage, advertising lights, loudspeakers, pictures, radio, television, wall notices, posters, billboards, apart from:
 Signage approved in writing by the Lessor; and
 Lessee's name on or near the doors of the Leased Premises in a form and manner approved or prescribed by the Lessor.
(ii) Without the Lessor’s prior written consent, the Lessee shall not use the Building's image or logo in any of the Lessee's publications, advertisements, promotions or events.
3. Payment of Service Charge: As prescribed in Article 2 and Item 15, Schedule 2 of this Agreement.
4. Promulgating and complying with the rules and regulations on management and operation of the Building: The Parties are responsible for complying with the rules and regulations on management and operation of the Leased Premises in particular and the Building in general as issued by the Lessor from time to time.
5. The Lessee is not allowed to use the Leased Premises for any purpose other than the Lease Purpose specified in this Article.
6. Repair and maintenance
a. During the Lease Term, the Lessor, at its own costs, is obliged to maintain and repair common systems and common technical structures of the Building constructed and installed by the Lessor, including: the structural ceiling system, the structural walls, the structural columns, the elevator system, the central air-conditioning system, electricity system and water supply system that are under common use and common supply for the Building (excluding lighting system inside the Premises and partitions, walls surrounding the Leased Premise).
b. During the Lease Term, the Lessee shall, at its own costs, maintain and repair the furniture, machineries, equipment and systems that are inside and/or related to and/or private use of the Leased Premises:
At its own costs, the Lessee shall:
(i) Whenever requested by the Lessor, the Lessee must hire a contractor appointed by the Lessor to maintain, repair and replace (partial or complete) the equipment of the air conditioning system, fire protection system, electricity system, water system (if any) together with their supplemental, replacements and alterations installed by the Lessor or the Lessee inside and/or private use of the Leased Premises to ensure all machineries, equipment and systems are always in normal working condition;
(ii) repair and replace (i) broken glass belonging to private use of the Leased Premises with glass of the same or similar quality, and (ii) lighting systems or electrical equipment within the Leased Premises which are damaged, broken, unusable or not working, and (iii) partitions, walls surrounding the Leased Premises, and (iv) other furniture, systems and equipment inside and/or in connection with and/or private use of the Leased Premises.
The Lessee is not allowed to take any actions that may cause to change, supplement or affect the common system or common structure of the Building without obtaining the Lessor’s prior written consent.
c. In the event the Lessee (i) damages or injures to Common Area or any part of the Building, or (ii) breaks any regulations on maintenance, repair or renovation of the Leased Premises, the Lessor will send a written notice to the Lessee stating the work must be remedied by the Lessee within the period as agreed in this Agreement or another reasonable period nominated by the Lessor, provided that the Lessor provide relevant sufficient evidences.
If the Lessee fails to carry out any work necessary to remedy the breach within the time limit stated in the Lessor's notice (or if the Lessee does not carry out the work as scheduled, or the results are remedied un-satisfying with the Lessor’s reasonable standard and quality), the Lessor shall access the Leased Premises and make such repairs. All arising costs are considered a debt payable by the Lessee to the Lessor within twenty-one (21) days from the date of receipt of the Lessor's written request.
d. The Lessor, at any time and without the prior consent of the Lessee, has the right to develop, repair, renovate, expand or narrow whole or any part of the Building, including Common Area (“Renovation Work”) provided that the Lessor has sent a written notice at least sixty (60) days in advance to the Lessee.
In necessary cases with advance notice, the Lessor has the right to use a part of the Leased Premises or enter and exit the Leased Premises to carry out the Renovation Work with provided that such Renovation Work shall not adversely affect the normal operation of the Lessee at the Premises. The Lessee acknowledges that the Lessee shall not object to the Renovation Work, or terminate the Agreement, or have any claim against the Lessor arising from or in connection with the Renovation Work, or withhold any payable amount under this Agreement due to the Renovation Work.
In necessary cases for the Renovation Work, the Lessor has the right, at any time, to relocate the Lessee to another premises within the Building provided that the Lessor must notify the Lessee in writing no later than sixty (60) days before the date of relocation. Reasonable costs of relocation will be agreed upon by the Parties in the spirit of mutual sharing. In the event that the Lessor sends a notice of relocation, and within thirty (30) days from the date of sending the notice of relocation, if the Parties cannot negotiate terms and conditions of the relocation, one of the Parties shall has the right to request termination of the Lease according to Article 10.1(i) by sending a written notice to the other party thirty (30) days prior to the date of request to terminate the Lease.
The Lessee shall exempt the Lessor from all liability for any damages the Lessee might suffer concerning the relocation of the Leased Premises and/or interruption of operations due to the Renovation Work.
e. Access the Leased Premises
At any time and subject to reasonable prior notice (except for cases that the Lessor considers an emergency or affecting the safety and security of the Building), the Lessor (including agents, workers and staffs of the Lessor) has the right to enter the Leased Premises to:
(i) Inspect, clean, relocate, replace, supplement or perform any work related to the property, equipment and/or Services of the Lessor at the Leased Premises;
(ii) In case arising any breach of commitment, damage, loss, relocation of devices which is prohibited from removing or changing, being installed with the equipment by the Lessee without the Lessor’s consent, and the Lessee fails to repair, replace or remove such items within the reasonably requested timeline, the Lessor shall carry out such remedy, replacement or relocation and all incurred costs shall be reimbursed by the Lessee;
(iii) Carry out maintenance, repair, replacement, new installation of equipment or any other work that the Lessor considers necessary to any part of the Leased Premises and/or the Building;
(iv) Perform works related to the development of the Building, including the right to build on, install or expand the boundary walls of the Leased Premises.
When accessing the Leased Premises to execute the works as mentioned above, the Lessor (including the Lessor's agents, workers, and staffs) shall not have to compensate for any nuisance or damage caused to Lessee provided that the Lessor exercises such rights in a reasonable and careful manner.
7. Waste collection
The Lessee is not allowed to pile trash in the Leased Premises or Common Area of the Building and must ensure at all times that trash and debris from the Leased Premises are transported to locations as prescribed by the Lessor. The Lessee must ensure that all kitchen and household waste is tightly wrapped in garbage bags before disposal. In case of the Lessee's fault, the Lessor shall transport and dispose the trash at the Lessee's costs. The Lessee is not allowed to transport the trash by passenger elevator.
ARTICLE 6. RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS OF THE LESSOR
1. Rights of the Lessor:
a. To request the Lessee to take over the Leased Premises according to the term agreed in Article 4 hereof;
b. To request the Lessee to fully and duly pay the Rent, Security Deposit, Service Charge, VAT and all fees as specified in the Agreement according to the payment schedule and method as agreed in Article 3 and the corresponding items in Schedule 2 of this Agreement;

d. To request the Lessee to compensate or remedy damage caused by the Lessee's fault;
e. To renovate, upgrade, and make changes to the Leased Premises when agreed by the Lessee or when the Lessor considers it necessary to ensure the safety of the Leased Premises and/or the Building but must not affect the Lessee unless otherwise necessary or agreed upon;

g. To request the Lessee to return the Leased Premises in the same condition as when it was handed over to the Lessee at the end of the Lease Term or other cases specified in this Agreement;
h. To access the Leased Premises to maintain, repair, periodically inspect equipment, and check the condition of the Leased Premises, provided that the Lessor has sent written notice to the Lessee at least one (01) day in advance before exercising the right to access the Leased Premises;
i. To assign or transfer part or all of the rights and obligations of the Lessor under this Agreement to any third party without the Lessee’s consent provided that the transferee agrees to take over the rights and obligations of the Lessor under this Agreement. At that time, the Lessee shall sign the necessary documents and agreements related to the transfer at the request of the Lessor;
j. Before three (03) months to the expiry of the Lease Term and the Lessor has not received a Renewal Proposal from the Lessee, the Lessor can notice to re-letting the Leased Premises and allow guests or agents of the Lessor to visit the Leased Premises without any hindrance from the Lessee, provided that the Lessor has notified the Lessee in advance (either verbally or by email); and
k. Other rights specified in this Agreement and regulated by the laws of Vietnam.
2. Obligations of the Lessor
a. To hand over the Leased Premises to the Lessee as agreed herein and guide the Lessee to use the Leased Premises in proper with its function and design as set out in Article 1 of this Agreement;
b. To guarantee the Lessee’s right to stably and comprehensively use the Leased Premises during the Lease Term;
c. To maintain and repair the Leased Premises periodically or according to agreement;
d. Not to unilaterally terminate the Agreement when the Lessee properly performs its obligations under the Agreement, unless the Lessee agrees to terminate the Agreement or in cases where the Lessor is entitled to unilaterally terminate specified in this Agreement;
e. To compensate for damages caused by the Lessor’s fault;
f. To fulfill financial obligations to the State Authority in accordance with the laws;
g. To ensure that the Leased Premises has minimum areas for basic electrical equipment, tap water, air conditioning, toilets, and surveillance camera systems;
h. To maintain the Common Area in good condition, repair and restore damaged parts, unless such damage is due to the fault of the Lessee or a Related Person of the Lessee;
i. To ensure hygiene and security for the Common Area of the Building;
j. To be responsible for obtaining, at its own costs, any and all consents related to the Lessor’s signing and performance of this Agreement;
k. To immediately notify the Lessee in writing in the following cases:
 any damage arising to the Building that may adversely affect the Lessee and the Lessee's business operations;
 any notice, demand or claim relating to the Lessor made by any person in connection with the Leased Premises, including:
(x) in relation to any matter that may, or will, give rise to any termination, repudiation or impairment of this Agreement or the Lessee's rights conferred hereunder;
(y) in connection with the termination of any consent or any threat, withdrawal, cancellation or termination of any consent in connection with the signing or performance of this Agreement;
(z) relating to Lessee's use of the Leased Premises under this Agreement.
l. Other obligations specified in this Agreement, signed documents related to the Leased Premises and applicable laws.
3. Commitments and warranties of the Lessor
a. The Lessor is a company duly incorporated and registered under the laws of Vietnam, with full power and authority to enter into this Agreement and perform its obligations under the terms and conditions hereof;
b. The representative who has signed this Agreement on behalf of the Lessor is fully and legally authorized to sign this Agreement;
1.
c. The Lessor has obtained the necessary consents related to the signing, performance, validity and enforceability of this Agreement;

2.

g. The Lessor 's signing, delivery and performance of this Agreement shall not:
3.
(i) violate, contradict or lead to the violation of any provisions of the Lessor's organizational documents; or
(ii) constitute a violation of any law, rule, regulation, order, judgment, decree, agreement, promissory note, mortgage or any other document, of which Lessor is a party or upon which the Lessor or any of its assets are bound or affected.
ARTICLE 7. RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS OF THE LESSEE
1. Rights of the Lessee
a. To request the Lessor to hand over the Leased Premises in accordance with the status specified in Article 1 of this Agreement;
b. To request the Lessor to provide complete and truthful information about the Leased Premises;
c. To exchange the Leased Premises with another Lessee upon the Lessor’s prior written consent;
d. To sublease part or all of the Leased Premises as agreed in this Agreement or upon the Lessor’s prior written consent;
e. To continuously rent the Leased Premises under the terms agreed with the Lessor to the extent approved by the new owner in case of change of owner;
f. To request the Lessor to repair the Leased Premises in case the Leased Premises is damaged due to the Lessor's fault;
g. To request the Lessor to compensate for damages caused by the Lessor's fault;
h. To unilateral termination this Agreement according to the provisions specified in Article 8, Article 10 of this Agreement;
i. If, at any time, any person or entity who shall acquire or succeed to the interests of Lessor under the Lease (“New Owner”), so long as the Lessee is not in default in the performance of its payment obligaitons under the Agreement, the Agreement shall continue in full force and effect as a direct lease between the New Owner and Lessee, upon and subject to all of the terms, covenants and conditions of the Agreement. The Lessee hereby agrees to attorn to and accept the New Owner as Lessor under the Agreement and to be bound by and perform all of the obligations imposed by the Lease, and the New Owner, agrees that it will not disturb the possession of the Lessee with respect to the Premises and will be bound by all of the obligations imposed on the Lessor by the Lease;
j. Other rights specified in this Agreement and regulated by the laws.
2. Obligations of the Lessee
a. To preserve and use the Leased Premises in proper with its function and design as set out in Article 1 and other agreements indicated herein;
b. To pay the Rent, Service Charge and other related fees/payable amounts in full and by the method agreed in Article 2 and Article 3 of this Agreement;
c. To use the Leased Premises for the exacct purpose and remedy the damages to the Leased Premises caused by the Lessee’s fault;
d. To return the Leased Premises to the Lessor according to Article 4.7 of the Lease;
e. Not to change, renovate or dismantle the Leased Premises without the Lessor’s written consent;
f. To compensate for damages caused by the Lessee’s fault;
g. To ensure that on the date of signing this Agreement, the Lessee has met all the conditions prescribed by the laws to carry out the Lessee's professions and business activities in the Leased Premises;
h. The Lessee, at its own costs, shall:
(i) obtain and maintain insurance on all Lessee's assets within the Leased Premises at the full insured value of the assets for all risks insured against such assets;
(ii) obtain and maintain insurance covering all risks and damages to the Leased Premises, equipment, fixtures, installments permanently installed in the Leased Premises, all fixtures and fittings and objects in the Leased Premises and all parts thereof according to their values and including risks arising from the Lessee's activities carried out in the Leased Premises as may from time to time be reasonably determined by the Lessor in writting;
(iii) purchase full public liability insurance covering all claims for personal injury, death or property damage or loss;
(iv) purchase or ensure that contractors purchase all-risk insurance, third party liability insurance and professional liability insurance in relation to Fit-out Work and all finishing works of the Leased Premises and all repairs, changes to the Leased Premises in later stages; and
(v) purchase and maintain any other appropriate insurance that may be required under Vietnamese laws.
Insurance contracts must be in force from the Handover Date and throughout the period of Lessee's occupation of the Leased Premises until the Expiry Date or on the date the Lessee has handed over the Leased Premises to the Lessor, whichever comes later.
Without prejudice to any other indemnity responsibilities of the Lessee as provided under this Agreement, if any damage and/or loss caused by the Lessee to the Lessor or a third party and the insurance monies are irrecoverable or not covered enough, the Lessee shall immediately pay the affected party the amount not covered by insurance or the insufficiency offset amount;
i. Prior to the Handover Date, the Lessee shall send to the Lessor a copy of the insurance contracts in effect as set forth in this Agreement and for the duration that the Lessee still occupies the Leased Premises, and shall provide evidence of the extension of such contracts to the Lessor in case these contracts expire during the Lease Term without the Lessor's request;
j. At the Lessor's request, the Lessee shall take necessary actions to have the Lessor recorded as the beneficiary of insurance for the Leased Premises purchased at the Lessee's costs;
k. The Lessee must take all reasonable precautions to prevent fire from breaking out or occurring in the Leased Premises and comply with all requirements of the competent State Authority as well as the Lessor relating to the precautions of fire in the Leased Premises. In addition, the Lessee must participate in fire prevention drills (including the appointment of fire warden, if necessary) conducted by the Lessor or the State Authority;
l. The Lessee shall, at its own costs, take necessary steps and measures to prevent any outbreak, spread or any transmission whatsoever of any infectious disease, including but not limited to thoroughly fumigating and disinfecting the Premises for reasonable satisfaction of the Lessor and/or relevant State Authority. The Lessee must comply with the provisions of the laws, regulations, instructions and notices of the Lessor and/or the competent State Authority from time to time related to the prevention of infectious diseases;
m. To meet all prescribed conditions to carry out the Lessee's business activities in the Leased Premises;
n. To compensate for damages caused by the Lessee’s fault during the use and possession of the Leased Premises and/or the Building;
o. To submit the design of the Leased Premises to the Lessor for getting the Lessor’s approval before commencing the renovation, repair, and installation of equipment for the Leased Premises. For clarity, the Lessor's approval of the design of the Leased Premises does not exempt the Lessee’s obligation for loss, damage or expenses that occurred due to (but not limited to) at) any mistake or other reasons belonging to such design;
p. To bear all costs for the Premises’ design and fitting out and for additional installation of the electricity system, fire fighting and prevention system, equipment or facility…within the Leased Premises after obtaining the Lessor’s approval on the same. As for the fire fighting and prevention system inside the Premises, the Lessee shall be responsible for preparing design dossiers and asking for appraisal and approval from the competent State Authority before construction and installation. Furthermore, the Lessee must get approval from the competent State Authority to putting the fire fighting and prevention system into use and provide the Lessor with a copy of such approval documents;
q. Lessee shall not store or bring into the Leased Premises any flammable or explosive materials, substances or liquids;
r. The Lessee is not allowed and ensures that its staff, suppliers, clients or any third party concerning the Lessee’s business not to do anything that causes or may cause any danger, noise, annoyance or nuisance to the ordinary operations of the Building, other lessees or other parties in the Building or other neighboring premises, as Lessor’s reasonable discretion, may affect to the image and reputation of the Building;
s. To be responsible for obtaining any and all approvals at its own costs relating to:
 the signing and implementation of this Agreement by the Lessee;
 the implementation of the Lessee's professions and business activities in the Leased Premises;
 the Lessee shall be obligated to supplement and ensure that such consents are available and in full force and effect on the date of signing this Agreement and shall remain such consent throughout the Lease Term.
t. To maintain and ensure that the Lessee's personnel maintain the hygiene and security of the Leased Premises and Common Area;
u. The Lessee must nominate its representative to attend meetings with all of other lessees held by the Lessor on issues related to the Building, if the Lessee does not attend those meetings, the Lessee must still have to comply with the decisions as voted through those meetings.
v. The Lessee must immediately notify the Lessor of the change in address for receiving payment requests or notices from the Lessor.
w. To provide one telephone number and representative in order for the Lessor to contact in case of necessary and must timely update to the Lessor for any change concerning such telephone number and representative;
x. To coordinate closely with the Lessor participating in activities for the common purpose of the Building or other activities hosted by the competent State Authority, which require the Lessor and its partners to participate;
y. To immediately notify the Lessor in writing of the following cases:
 there is any damage to the Leased Premises;
 any circumstances which may be dangerous or which may cause any damage or danger to the Leased Premises or any person in the Leased Premises;
 any notice, demand or claim relating to the Lessee made by any person in connection with the Leased Premises, including:
(x) in connection with any matter that may, or will, give rise to any termination, repudiation or impairment of this Agreement or of the Lessor's rights conferred hereunder;
(y) in connection with the termination of any consent or any threat, withdrawal, cancellation or termination of any consent in connection with the conclusion, performance of this Agreement or the business activities of the Lessee in the Leased Premises; and
(z) in relation to the use of the Leased Premises for the Lease Purpose.
z. To ensure that the Lessee and other relevant parties will sign (or ensure the signing) of other documents required by the laws or necessary to implement and establish the validity of this Agreement;
a. The Lessee's rights and obligations under this Agreement shall not be transferred or assigned to any third party, except with the prior written consent of the Lessor;
b. To comply with all applicable laws and reasonable requests and proposals of any State Authority relating to, or affecting the Leased Premises in any way, or relating to the use of the Leased Premises for the Lease Purpose, including but not limited to issues related to architecture, machinery and equipment, standards and legal regulations on environmental protection and fire prevention;
c. At the end of the Lease Term or other cases of termination of this Agreement, the Lessee must return the Leased Premises to the Lessor in the same condition as when it was handed over to the Lessee;
d. To comply with regulations of the State Authority and the Lessor related to fire fighting and prevention and environmental protection, food hygiene and safety, labor safety, management and use of the Leased Premises throughout the management and use of the Leased Premises; and
e. Other obligations specified in this Agreement, signed documents related to the Leased Premises and applicable laws.
3. Commitments and warranties of the Lessee
a. The Lessee is a company duly incorporated and registered under the laws of Vietnam, with full power and authority to enter into this Agreement and perform its obligations under the terms and conditions of hereof;
b. The representative who has signed this Agreement on behalf of the Lessee is fully and legally authorized to sign this Agreement;
4.
c. The Lessee has obtained the necessary consents related to the signing, performance, validity and enforceability of this Agreement;
d. The Lessee shall comply with all commitments and warranties as stipulated in this Agreement;
e. The Leased Premises shall be used for the Lease Purpose only;
5.
f. The Lessee’s signing, delivery and performance of this Agreement shall not:
6.

7.

8.

9.
(i) the Lessee's leasing and business activities in the Leased Premises;
(ii) meet all business conditions with business lines that meet the conditions prescribed by laws;
(iii) such consents are in full force and effect and the Lessee has, at all times, complied with the terms and conditions of such consents and has paid all fees due in connection therewith and not violate any conditions under which such consents affect the exercise of rights and/or fulfillment of obligations of the Lessee in this Agreement, signed documents, and applicable laws; and
(iv) The Lessee shall implement and fully comply with the provisions of this Agreement.
ARTICLE 8. LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF CONTRACT
1. The Lessor’s liability in breach of the Agreement:
In case the Lessor commits any breach, failure to perform or delay in performing the Lessor's obligations under this Agreement, unless otherwise stipulated in the Agreement or the Lessor's breach arising from a breach of the Lessee's commitments, warranties or obligations, the Lessee shall have the following rights:
a. To request the Lessor to:
(i) remedy all breaches of its commitment, guarantee, or obligation in this Agreement as soon as practicable as notified in writing by the Lessee. The Lessor must also remedy such breaches within thirty (30) Business Days after receiving notice from the Lessee (except in cases where the breach is of an urgent nature and directly adversely affects the Lessee, the Lessor must remedy the breach within a reasonable timeline requested by the Lessee). For breaches that require a longer timeline to remedy, the Lessor must notify the Lessee of a specific timeline to remedy such violations;
(ii) compensate the Lessee for damages arising due to the Lessor's breach. For the avoidance of doubt, total compensation will not exceed the Security Deposit.
b. In the event the Lessor fails to comply with the Lessee's request specified in Article 8.1(a) above, the Lessee has the right to unilaterally terminate the Agreement and request the Lessor to compensate for damages arising due to the Lessor’s breach. For the avoidance of doubt, total compensation will not exceed the Security Deposit.
2. The Lessee’s liability in breach of the Agreement:
In case the Lessee commits any breach, failure to perform or delay in performing the Lessee's obligations under this Agreement, the Lessor shall have the following rights:
a. To stop providing the Service and utilities to the Leased Premises until the Lessee remedy all violations; and/or
b. To request the Lessee to remedy all breaches of its commitment, guarantee, or obligation in this Agreement as soon as practicable as notified in writing by the Lessor, in any case, the breach must be remedied within (i) twenty (20) Business Days for violations of payment obligations and (ii) thirty (30) Business Days after receiving notice from the Lessor for the remaining violations (except in cases where the breach is of an urgent nature and directly adversely affects the Lessor, the Lessee must remedy the breach within a reasonable timeline requested by the Lessor). For breaches that require a longer timeline to remedy, the Lessee must notify the Lessor of a specific timeline to remedy such violations and obtain the Lessor's approval. If the Lessee fails to do so, the Lessor may (to the extent practicable) remedy the Lessee's breach and and request the Lessee to reimburse all related costs and expenses, provided that the Lessor provides sufficient relevant evidences in writing regarding the costs and expenses directly incurred by the Lessor in remedying the breach and that these payments are consistent with the average transaction price on the market; and/or
c. To request the Lessee to compensate the Lessor for all damage arising due to:
(i) any breach or failure to comply with any of the Lessee's representations, warranties or obligations under this Agreement by the Lessee or any Related Person of the Lessee;
(ii) any act, omission or default of the Lessee or any person with the Lessee's express consent at the Leased Premises;
(iii) termination of this Agreement due to the Lessee's fault or in cases where the Lessee does not have the right to unilaterally terminate the Agreement or the Lessor's loss of rights and interests to the Leased Premises due to the Lessee's actions and/or Related Person of the Lessee.
d. To unilaterally terminate the Agreement and request the Lessee to compensate for all damage arising from the Lessee's breach.
3. Force majeure event: The Lessee or Lessor is not considered to be in breach of the Agreement and is not fined or liable for damages if the delay or fail to perform obligations stated in this Agreement is due to a force majeure event, accordingly:
a. A force majeure event is an objective event that is unforeseeable and irremediable, affecting the performance of any obligations hereunder by either Party even though all necessary and permissible measures having been exercised, including: war, rebellion, sabotage, strike (not attributable to the Parties’ faults), natural disaster, communicable disease endorsement; unusual geological conditions beyond the control of the parties; changes in legal policies by the State; compulsory implementation of urgent order, decision or request of competent State Authority arising not due to either Party’s fault or other cases stipulated by law (“Force Majeure Event”).
b. When either Party fail to perform a part or all of their contractual obligations directly due to Force Majeure Event, it will not be considered in breach of the Agreement if all of the following conditions are met:
(i) Force Majeure Event directly results in the interruption or delay of the performance of contractual obligations;
(ii) The Party experiencing the Force Majeure Event has made every effort to fulfill their contractual obligations and minimize damages caused to the other Party by the Force Majeure Event; and
(iii) At the time of the Force Majeure Event occurs, the Party experiencing the Force Majeure Event shall inform the other Party immediately and provide the written notice of the Force Majeure Event and explain the reason for their interruption or delay in the performance of its obligations.must immediately notify the other Party as well as provide written notice and explanation of the reason causing the interruption or delay in performing its obligations.
c. When the abovementioned conditions are met, the affected Party’s failure in performance of its obligations due to the Force Majeure Event shall neither constitute a breach of this Agreement nor the basis for such Party’s unilateral termination of this Agreement, except for the case provided in Article 8.3(d) below. To avoid doubt, the Lessee is still responsible for paying the Rent, Service Charge, corresponding VAT, and other payable fees/amounts related to the Agreement during the Force Majeure Event.
d. If the Force Majeure Event lasts for more than three (03) months, each Party shall have the right to unilaterally terminate the Agreement. The unilateral termination in this case shall not be deemed as breach of the Agreement and either Party shall not be subject to compensation and penalty to the other Party. The Lessee will pay the Rent, Service Charge, corresponding VAT, and other payable fees/amounts until the termination date.
4. Except for the cases specified in this Agreement, the Parties may not unilaterally terminate this Agreement during the Lease Term.
ARTICLE 9. PENALTIES FOR BREACH OF CONTRACT
1. If either Party breaches the Agreement, it will be subject to a penalty of 8% (eight percent) of the breached contract value of the Agreement and must pay at the request of the other Party. However, no penalty shall be imposed in the event that the breach by the Lessee arises due to unavoidable reasons such as changes in internal policies, withdrawal of the business, force majeure, or other circumstances beyond its reasonable control, and such reasons are notified in writing and agreed upon by both Parties.This provision is in addition to and does not affect any other remedies available to the other Party under this Agreement.
2. In the event the Lessee fails to make payments in due under this Agreement to the Lessor (whether or not the Lessee receives Payment request from the Lessor), the Lessee shall pay the Lessor the Late Payment Interest of 0.05%/day on the overdue amount. Nevertheless, the Late Payment Interest shall not apply if the delay is caused by unavoidable or justifiable reasons including but not limited to internal administrative changes, system issues, or force majeure events, and provided that the Lessee notifies the Lessor promptly in writing. Additionally, if both Parties mutually agree in writing, the imposition of Late Payment Interest may be waived or modified.
ARTICLE 10. TERMINATION OF THE LEASE AND SETTLEMENT
1. Cases of termination of the Agreement:
a. The Parties agree to terminate the Agreement. In this case, the Parties shall make a written agreement specified the conditions and the time of the termination of this Agreement;
b. By a decision of the Lessor in case payment is overdue for twenty (20) Business Days in which the Lessee is late in making any amount of Rent, Security Deposit, Service Charge, utility charge or other payable amounts as agreed in Article 2, Article 3 and other terms of this Agreement;
c. By the decision of the Lessee in case the Lessor delays handing over the Leased Premises as agreed in Article 4 of this Agreement without the fault of the Lessee or a Related Person of the Lessee;
d. In case a Party is affected by a force majeure event specified in Article 8.3 of the Lease and cannot overcome it in order to continue performing its obligations within sixty (60) days from the date of occurrence of the Force Majeure event and the Parties have not agreed otherwise, either Party has the right to unilaterally terminate this Agreement and such termination is not considered a breach of the Agreement;
e. The Lease Term expires without renewal by the Parties;
f. The Lessor decides to terminate the Agreement according to the provisions of Article 8.2 above;
g. The Lessee decides to terminate the Agreement according to the provisions of Article 8.1 above;
h. One Party falls into bankruptcy or dissolution in accordance with the laws; or
i. Notwithstanding the provisions of this Agreement and/or regardless of whether the Parties have agreed to extend the Agreement, , the Lessor has the right to terminate the Lease before the Expiration Date by giving written notice to the Lessee twelve (12) months in advance, or one other reasonable time, in the following events:
(i) The Building is to be demolished or reconstructed at the Lessor's sole discretion; or
(ii) In Lessor's sole discretion, the Building or portion thereof needs to be renovated, retrofitted, refurbished and/or altered and the Lessor requires possession of the Leased Premises for such purpose(s); or
(iii) There is a change in the purpose of use of the Building or any part thereof, at the sole discretion of the Lessor, that affects the use of the Leased Premises; or
(iv) The Building or any part thereof must be ceased operation or taken over by a competent State Authority or transferred to a third party according to a notice, order or decision of a competent State Authority; or
(v) Other reasons leading to the Lessor's ownership of the Leased Premises being changed.
2. Settlement of the consequences of termination of the Agreement as specified in Clause 1 of this Article:
a. In the event the Lease is terminated according to Article 10.1(a), Article 10.1(c), Article 10.1(d), Article 10.1(e), Article 10.1(g), and Article 10.1(i) then: (i) The Lessee shall pay the Lessor all Rent, Service Charge, corresponding VAT and any other payable amounts (if any) under the Agreement up to the termination date, and (ii) the Lessor shall refund the remainder of the Security Deposit to the Lessee after deducting amounts that must be deducted from the Security Deposit as prescribed in Article 2.3(c) of this Agreement. In case the Security Deposit is not enough to offset the amounts that the Lessee must pay under this Agreement, the Lessor has the right to request the Lessee to pay the amount exceeding the Security Deposit amount, including penalties for violations, compensate for damages (if any) provided that the Lessor provides all relevant invoices and documents.
b. In the event the Agreement is terminated according to Article 10.1(b) and Article 10.1(f), then: (i) The Lessee shall pay the Lessor all Rent, Service Charge, and corresponding VAT, and any other payable amounts (if any) under the Lease up to the termination date, (ii) the Lessor shall not refund the Security Deposit to the Lessee, and (iii) the Lessee must compensate any actual damages incurred to the Lessor, including but not limited to: all costs related to remedying the breach and/or returning the Leased Premises, costs arising from subleasing the Leased Premises and other damages (if any).
c. In the event the Agreement is terminated according to Article 10.1(h), then: (i) The bankrupt or dissolved party must follow bankruptcy or dissolution procedures regulated by the laws; (ii) the Lessee shall pay the Lessor all Rent, Service Charge, corresponding VAT and any other payable amounts (if any) under the Agreement up to the termination date and the Lessor will return the remainder of the Security Deposit to the Lessee after deducting amounts that must be deducted from the Security Deposit as prescribed in Article 2.3(c) of this Agreement. In case the Security Deposit is not enough to offset the amounts that the Lessee must pay under this Agreement, the Lessor has the right to request the Lessee to pay the amount exceeding the Security Deposit amount, including penalties for violations, compensate for damages (if any) provided that the Lessor provides all relevant invoices and documents.
d. In the event the Agreement is terminated according to Atricle 10.1 (i) or anyother reason which is attributable to Lessor, then : the Lessor shall refund the remainder of the Security Deposit to the Lessee and compensate the lessee an amount equivalent to twelve months’ rent as Penalty.
3. Procedure for termination of the Agreement:
In order to terminate the Agreement according to the provisions of Article 10.1 above, the Parties must perform the following works:
a. Except for the cases specified in Article 10.1(a), Article 10.1(e), Article 10.1(h) and Article 10.1(i), the Party requesting to terminate the Agreement must notify the other Party in writing regarding the termination of the Agreement at least thirty (30) in advance of the termination date.
b. The Security Deposit shall be refunded in accordance with Article 2.3(c) and Article 10.2 of the Agreement.
c. Payment of Rent, Service Charge and any other payable amounts (if any) shall be settled in accordance with Article 10.2 above and must be paid no later than five (05) days from the due date stated in the Lessor's Payment request.
d. The Lessee must return the Leased Premises to the Lessor in accordance with Article 4.7 and Article 7.2(d) of the Agreement.
ARTICLE 11. DISPUTE SETTLEMENT
1. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.
2. In case of any dispute arising regarding the contents of this Agreement, the two Parties shall discuss and resolve it through negotiation. Within sixty (60) days from the date either Party notifies the other Party in writing of a dispute that has arisen but that dispute cannot be resolved by negotiation, each Party has the right to file a petition to a competent court to resolve the dispute in accordance with the laws of Vietnam.
3. In case it is allowed by the laws, the Parties acknowledge and agree to chose the dispute resolution agency as the Vietnam International Arbitration Center in addition to the Vietnam Chamber of Commerce and Industry (VIAC) in accordance with the Rules of Arbitration of VIAC being in force from time to time, the place of arbitration shall be in Ho Chi Minh City and the arbitration tribunal shall consist of three arbitrators. Each Party selects one arbitrator, the two selected arbitrators will select the final arbitrator. The award of the arbitration tribunal is final and binding on the Parties.
ARTICLE 12. VALIDITY OF THE AGREEMENT
1. This Agreement takes effect from the date of signing.
2. This Agreement is made into four (04) copies in English and four (04) copies in Vietnamese, with the same legal value, the Lessor keeps two (02) copies of each language, the Lessee keeps two (02) copies of each language for record and proceeding the payment of taxes, fees and charges according to the provisions of the laws. In case there are difference or inconsistency between the English and Vietnamese versions, the Vietnamese version shall prevail.
3. Attached to this Agreement are documents relating to the Building (if there is an agreement on providing such documents).
The schedules attached to this Agreement, the Building Regulations and amendments and supplements as agreed by both Parties are intergal parts of this Agreement and are in full force and effect to the Parties and supersede any previous agreement, understanding, arrangement, communication or expression of intent, regarding the contents hereof.
4. In case the Parties agree to amend this Agreement, such amendment must be made in writing and signed by both Parties.
ARTICLE 13. MISCELLANEOUS
1. Comply with the Building Regulations
a. By signing this Agreement, the Lessee acknowledges and commits to fully comply with the Building Regulations issued by the Lessor and attached in Schedule 6 hereof (“Building Regulations”), as amended from time to time and ensure that all agents, employees or clients or any third party involved in its business activities abided by of such Building Regulations. Violations of the Building Regulations by the Lessee, the Lessee's agents/employees/clients/related third parties that causes damage to the Lessor are also considered as the Lessee’s breach of this Agreement.
b. The Lessor has the right, from time to time and with a one (01) month advance written notice to the Lessee, to make any and/or issue, change, amend, accept or delete any content of the Lessees’ Guide as it may consider necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Building and/or the Leased Premises.
c. The Building Regulations shall supplement the terms and conditions stated in the Agreement and shall not affect the terms and conditions of the Agreement.
d. In case of conflict between the Building Regulations and the terms and conditions hereof, the terms and conditions of the Agreement shall prevail.
2. Notice
a. Notice means any announcement, offer, request or any other communication of each Party or Parties in this Agreement (“Notice”) and shall be in written form.
b. Method of notice: the Notice shall be delivered by one of the following ways: by direct delivery, by post/express, or by email.
c. Address to receive Notice:
(i) If sent by hand or by post/express delivery: the address to receive the Notice is the address each Party stated at the introduction part of this Agreement.
(ii) If sent by email: the email address to receive the Notice is the email address of each Party listed at the introduction part of this Agreement or the email address of the personnel in charge of leasing the Leased Premises of each Party.
d. Each Party must notify the other Party of the change in its address for receiving Notices.
e. Time of receipt of the Notice: If there is no other clear evidence to substantiate an earlier time of receipt, then the Notice shall be implicitly deemed as received at the time of:
(i) at the time of delivery, in case of direct delivery with receipt;
(ii) 01 hour after sending the email;
(iii) 48 hours after sending, if sent by post/express delivery service.
In case the recipient is an enterprise/organization, if the time of receipt of Notice does not fall into Business Hours, then the next earliest Business Hour of the enterprise/organization shall be deemed as the time of receipt of Notice.
3. Each Party shall keep all Confidential Information in confidential and not disclose it to anyone without any prior consent of the other Party, except it is provided to the competent State Authority upon request.
4. The failure of either Party hereto at any time to require performance by the other party of any of its obligations hereunder shall in no way affect the full right to require such performance at any time thereafter. The waiver by either Party of a remedy concerning a breach of any provision hereof shall not be taken as a waiver of a remedy concerning any succeeding breach of such a provision or any breach of other provisions.
Any part, clause or provision of this Agreement which is held to be illegal, void, invalid or unenforceable under the laws of Vietnam shall be deemed inoperative between the Parties, without invalidating the remaining provisions of this Agreement which shall remain in full force and effect.
