SCHEDULE 1 – DEFINITION AND INTERPRETATION
In this Agreement, the following terms are interpreted as follows:
1. “State Authority” means any and/or all of the followings: Ho Chi Minh City People's Committee, Thu Duc City People's Committee, Ho Chi Minh City Department of Natural Resouces and Environment, and other state authorities of Ho Chi Minh City, Thu Duc City; specialized construction agencies under the Ministry of Construction and other competant state authorities of Vietnam according to the laws.
2. “Service” means services as described in Schedule 3 hereof, provided by the Lessor on the basis of Lessee paying the Service Charge.
3. “Building Management” means the Lessor’ agency to manages and operates the Building.
4. “Business Hours” means the following times (exclusive of the public holidays as regulated by the laws or official announcement of the competent authorities): From Monday to Friday: 8:00 – 18:00 and Saturday: 8:00 – 12:00.
5. “Agreement” means this Office lease agreement, attaching its Schedules and internal regulations of the Lessor.
6. “Leased Premises” means the area in the Building rented by the Lessee as specified in Item 4 of Schedule 2 hereof and includes:
a. plaster wall and other finishes affixed to the interior of the walls outside the Leased Premises (this expression includes all walls of the Leased Premises forming the boundary between the Leased Premises and the leased premises adjacent to other lessees in the Building) but not other parts of external walls; finished or plastered parts of walls, floors, ceilings, doors, windows and attached or embedded structural columns inside the Leased Premises;
b. glasses and window frames (inner glass and frame only included if the window has double glazing);
c. all alterations, additions and renovations to the Leased Premises;
d. all fixtures, decorations, furnishings, equipment and assets of the Lessor within the Leased Premises from time to time; and
e. any sewers, wires, telecommunication cables, plumbing, ditches, pipes and other service facilities, sanitary appliances, room air conditioners, central air conditioners, any any security, fire protection, electrical and gas systems, installations and repairs from time to time within the Leased Premises or specifically serving the Leased Premises.
7. “Common Area” means the areas of the Building (whether part of the Building's structure or not) served for common use of all Lessees, other users in the Building, the Lessee and individuals authorized or permitted by the Lessee, other Lessees of the Building , and the Lanlord to use, including but not limited to entrance area, corridors, lobbies, stairs, rest rooms, walkways, elevators, courtyards, ramps, service areas and any other facilities but excluding any part of the Leased Premises and areas leased by other Lessees.
8. “Payment Period” means the payment period for the Rent and Service Charge provided by the Lessee to the Lessor under Item 17, Schedule 2 hereunder.
9. “Handover Date” means the date as described in Item 8, Schedule 2 hereunder.
10. “Commencement Date” means the date as described in Item 9, Schedule 2 hereunder.
11. “Rent Commencement Date” means the date as described in Item 11, Schedule 2 hereunder.
12. “ Expiry Date” means the date as described in Item 12, Schedule 2 hereunder.
13. “Business Day” means any day except for (i) Saturdays, or (ii) Sundays, or (iii) any day that banks are required or permitted to close in Vietnam, or (iv) any public holiday in Vietnam as regulated by Vietnam laws, or (v) any non-working day in Vietnam as officially notified by a state authority, and (vi) any non-working day on which each Party must close its headquarters or delay operations at the request of the state authority.
14. “Related Person”:
(a) of an individual, means (A) wife/husband, biological father, adoptive father, biological mother, adoptive mother, biological children and spouses of biological children, adopted children and spouses of adopted children and biological siblings; and (B) any person nominated by, controlled by or appointed to represent for such individual; and
(b) of a person who is not an individual, means a “Related Person” of that person as defined in Article 4.23 of Law on Enterprise No. 59/2020/QH14 enacted by the National Assembly of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam on June 17, 2020, as amended, supplemented from time to time.
15. “Service Charge” means the amount payable by the Lessee to the Lessor in accordance with Item 15, Schedule 2 to have the Lessor provide the Service.
16. “Force Majeure Event” means an objective event that is unforeseeable and irremediable affecting the performance of any obligations hereunder by either Party, regardless of all necessary and permissible measures. The events considered to be Force Majeure Event are specifically agreed by the Parties in Article 8.3(a) hereof.
17. “Lease Term” means the term of this Agreement as specified in Item 7, Schedule 2 hereunder.
18. “Fit-out Period” means the duration as specified in Article 4.6(a) hereof.
19. “Confidential Information” means all information (whether they are communicates in email, SMS or in written or oral) pertaining to the business, customer, personnel or any other issue of the Parties in this Agreement that is obtained or received by the Parties during negotiation of this Agreement.
20. “Offer to Lease” means the offer to lease regarding the lease of the Leased Premises of the Building sent by the Lessor to the Lessee.
21. “Security Deposit” has the meaning as defined in Item 19, Schedule 2 hereunder.
22. “Booking Deposit” has the meaning as defined in Item 18, Schedule 2 hereunder.
23. “Rent” means the amount payable by the Lessee to the Lessor to occupy and use the Leased Premises, as specified in Article 2.1 hereof.
24. “Building” means the Office, Commercial, Service Building at Tower B, Commercial and Service Area combined with High-rise Residence at Lot 1-13 in Functional Area No. 1- No. 15 Tran Bach Dang Street, Quarter 3, Thu Thiem Ward, Thu Duc City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
25. “VND” means “ Vietnamese Dong ” – the official currency of Vietnam.

Electricity charges are determined by multiplying the Unit Price by the total actual electricity consumption, and then adding a 5% electricity loss fee calculated based on the rate set by the power company.

SCHEDULE 6 – BUILDING REGULATIONS
For ease of reference, each provision set forth in this Building Regulations is hereinafter referred to as a "Regulation".
1. Access
(a) The Lessor reserves the right to refuse entry into Building to any person whom the Lessor believes, in good faith, is a threat to the security, reputation or assets of Building and/or its occupants.
(b) Prior written approval of the Lessor is required before the Lessee can erect or install doors, drains, iron grills, curtains, or any similar installations, whether temporary or permanent, at the entrance or exit of the Leased Premises or at any emergency exits from the Leased Premises or erect any doors or metal grills or gates that may violate the regulations in effect of Vietnamese government authorities from time to time, as well as violate any other aspects of such regulations or this Building Regulations.
(c) The Lessee shall not change any locks or install new additional locks or latches.
(d) The Lessee shall be solely responsible for any risks arising from theft or damage within the Leased Premises and agrees to always lock the Leased Premises upon request from the Lessor.
2. Signage
(a) The Lessee shall not display inside or outside the Leased Premises any signages or other devices, regardless of whether they are illuminated or non-illuminated, that can be seen from outside the Leased Premises, except for the nameplate or signboard of the Lessee located within the entrance of the Leased Premises. The size and position of such nameplate or signboard must be approved by the Lessor.
(b) The Lessor is the sole authority to approve or disapprove, and any approval of the Lessor shall be based on conditions deemed appropriate by the Lessor. The Lessor has the right to remove, at the costs and expense borne by the Lessee, any signage, boards, decorations or other devices attached, erected or displayed without the prior consent of the Lessor.
3. No drilling
The Lessee shall not drill or otherwise damage the surface of any component of the Leased Premises or the Building. The Lessee shall not be permitted to drill unless with the prior written approval of the Lessor and in the event that the Lessor approves drilling, the Lessor shall have the right to control such drilling.
4. No hanging flags or obstacles
(a) Except for obtaining a written approval of the Lessor in advance, the Lessee cannot erect, hang or paint flagpoles, antennas, or any other objects outside Building and the Lessee must not hang flags to be flown out of windows or any location within or on Building.
(b) The Lessee shall not stick advertisements or other objects that darken, obstruct or obscure the windows or light of the Leased Premises without the prior written approval of the Lessor.
5. Curtains and Drapes
All curtains and/or drapes used within the Leased Premises must always comply with the color and design standards of the standard curtains and/or drapes set by Building. To maintain consistent architecture throughout the entire Building, the Lessee shall only install blinds that are designed in accordance with the manufacturer's standard regulations specified by the Lessor at any time.
6. Water Pipeline Equipment
Water pipeline equipments shall only be used for the intended purpose as designed and installed. No litter or other foreign substances shall be disposed of inside these pipelines. The Lessee shall bear all costs related to repairing damages caused by improper use of plumbing and draignage system.
7. Use of the Lessor’s Name and Building
The Lessee shall not use the Lessor’s name/logo or any part thereof, or currently used by the Lessor for any activities related to the Lessee's business or any other purpose except for the purpose of incating the address and head office of the Lessee.
8. Signboard
The Lessor shall provide free space on the ground floor of Building for installation of one (1) signboard of the Lessee to indicate the location of the Leased Premises. The Lessee shall pay all costs of construction and installation of the signboard. The Lessee must inform the Lessor in writing of the accurate commercial name and detailed technical specifications of the signboard (font size, font type, material, lighting). The Lessee shall be responsible for all costs of repairing or replacing the Lessee’s name on this signboard, if necessary.
9. Maintenance disruption
In the event that Building is renovated, the Lessor has the right to change, reconstruct or modify the use of any parts of Building (including all permanent, semi-permanent equipment therein), as long as not impeding access to the Leased Premises and essential services are maintained.
10. Non-performance of any damaged acts
The Lessee shall not do or allow any acts within the Leased Premises or any part thereof that may hold the Lessor liable or legally responsible for injury caused to individuals or damage to property.
11. Window
Windows must always be kept closed and locked, except in emergency cases such as fire or malfunctioning of the air conditioning system, or under reasonable circumstances where the Lessee may open the windows for cleaning purpose.
12. No offers allowed
Offers and peddling within Building are strictly prohibited and the Lessee shall cooperate to prevent such activities.
13. No cooking - No unpleasant odor
(a) Except for obtaining a written approval of the Lessor in advance, which is rarely consented and subject to Clause 13(b) below, the Lessee shall not permit to cook or prepare food in the Leased Premises, expect for reheating pre-cooked food in a microwave.
(b) The Lessee shall not cause any unusual or unpleasant odors that may cause discomfort to other Lessees within Building, whether such odors are caused or emanate from the Leased Premises due to cooking, interior construction activities, or any other activities within the scope of the Leased Premises. The Lessor has full rights to define "unusual", "unpleasant" and "causing discomfort to other Lessees within Building" in particular case.
14. No noise disturbance
The Lessee shall not cause or allow making noise (including but not limited to sound from TV, radio or any other musical instruments capable of producing or giving rise to noise or music) that may cause annoyance or inconvenience to Lessees in other areas of the Building.
15. No pets
No animals or pets are allowed to be brought into or kept within the Leased Premises.
16. Waste disposal
On the daily basis, the Lessee shall dispose waste at a location designated by the Lessor, in accordance with reasonable regulations and principles that the Lessor may issue from time to time.
17. No obstruction in Common Areas
The Lessee shall not place or install any bins, goods, furniture, trash or other objects that obstruct the entrances, staircases, walkways, or loading and unloading locations shared with other lessees in other areas of the Building.
18. No unauthorized relocation or dismantling of furniture
The Lessee shall not relocate or dismantle safes, machinery, equipment, heavy objects, or bulky objects into or out of the Building without prior written approval of the Lessor; generally, the relocation of these objects shall only be done outside of Business Hours.
The Lessee shall ensure that these objects shall only be moved by freight elevator. The Lessor has the right to remove any items violates the Building Regulations or the Agreement. The Lessee shall ensure the Lessor is protected from any damages caused to people or property, or any damages and expenses incurred by the Lessor due to the movement of the aforementioned items, including but not limited to legal fees, repair costs for damages caused to Building or its dependent parts.
19. No overloading items
The Lessee shall not place any load on any floor within the Leased Premises that exceeds the load capacity of the floor. The Lessor reserves the right to regulate the weight and placement of all safes and heavy items to ensure proper weight distribution.
20. No alterations and additions
Without prior written approval of the Lessor, the Lessee shall not do or allow any alterations or additions to be made to the Leased Premises, the electrical system, or other permanent installations of the Lessor, or the installation of any machinery or equipment at the Leased Premises, or truncate, damage or permit truncation, damage or damage main door, windows, walls, structures or other materials.
21. No unauthorized installation of machinery or equipment
Without prior written approval of the Lessor, the Lessee shall not install and use air conditioners and other machinery or equipment within the Leased Premises, except for standard office equipment including fax machines, photocopiers, personal computers, printers, and equipment installed by the Lessor within the Leased Premises.
22. No alternative heating or cooling
The Lessee shall not use any form of heating or air conditioning other than those provided by the Lessor or any specialized system installed by the Lessor.
23. No vibrance disturbance
Machinery serving the operations and mechanical equipment allowed by the Lessor must be installed and maintained by the Lessee’s expense and at position that, as determined by the Lessor, absorb and prevent vibrations, noise, and/or disturbances to other lesses in Building.
24. No nuisance
The Lessee shall not cause or allow any actions within or at any part of the Leased Premises, at any time, as determined by the Lessor, may or become a nuisance or cause harm or disruption to the Lessor, other lesses, or users of Building, including adjacent areas, and in any form that violates the regulations and laws of Vietnam.
25. No illegal or unethical act
The Lessee shall not use the Leased Premises or any part thereof for any illegal or unethical purposes.
26. Only permitted and approved activities
The Lessee shall not use the Leased Premises for any purposes other than those specified in the Agreement, which includes compliances with the Building Regulations as a part of that Agreement, and the Lessee shall only conduct authorized business activities that have been legally authorized, licensed and approved by the compenent authorities, and shall comply with the conditions, terms and regulations related to such business activities as stated in the business license.
27. No overnight stays
Without prior written aproval of the Lessor, the Lessee shall not allow anyone to stay overnight in the Leased Premises. This permission shall only be granted by the Lessor when the Lessee appoints someone to watch over the belongings within the Leased Premises (if necessary), but the Leased Premises shall not be used as a sleeping or residential area within the definition of applicable regulations and laws of Vietnam.
28. No auctions
The Lessee shall not conduct or permit any auctions within the Leased Premises.
29. No storage of weapons and explosives
The Lessee shall not keep, store or allow the storage of any weapons, ammunition, potassium nitrate, gunpowder, kerosene, or other illegal explosives, fuels, materials, or dangerous substances within the Leased Premises that may pose a threat.
30. Maintain restroom
The Lessee, at its own expenses, shall keep the restroom facilities and water usage equipment designated for the Lessee’s use and its employees in clean and good working condition and shall not misuse or leave shared restroom facilities untidy when used by other lessees or users of the Bulding at any time during the Lease Term, in accordance with the Lessor's requirements, as well as the laws of Vietnam, and shall reimburse the Lessor for all costs incurred in cleaning and clearing clogged sewer pipes caused by careless, abnormal or improper use by the Lessee.
31. No flies, mosquitoes or insects
The Lessee shall ensure that the Leased Premises is free from flies, mosquitoes or insects. In the event that the Leased Premises has an infestation of flies, mosquitoes or insects, the Lessee shall bear the cost of extermination carried out by the Lessor or approval exterminations authorized to enter the Leased Premises for this purpose.
32. No access to the rooftop
No Lessee, employee or guest shall have access to the roof of Building except circumstances specified in this Agreement.
33. Return of the Leased Premises
After termination of the Agreement, the Lessee shall immediately return the Leased Premises in its original condition, except for any alterations, modifications or additional repairs (approved by the Lessor) that have been agreed to be retained, and shall return all office keys and restroom keys used by the Lessee to the Lessor.
34. Key return
The Lessee shall return all keys, key cards or access cards at the end of their lease term and shall responsible for the cost of replacing lost keys, key cards and access cards.
35. Parking area regulations
The Lessee shall comply with the parking lot regulations issued by the Lessor from time to time, including but not limited to the following regulations:
(a) No repairing or washing vehicles in the parking area;
(b) Must follow the instructions or directives of the security guard or individuals designated by the Lessor;
(c) Vehicles must be parked properly and in designated area, without obstructing pathways or impeding the parking of others;
(d) Vehicle owners are fully responsible for the actions, negligence, or shortcomings of their driver;
(e) Vehicle owners are required to adhere to parking regulations and comply with signs and signals within the parking lot;
(f) Vehicle owners bear full or partial legal liable for any damages, injuries caused to Building or other relevant property;
(g) The Lessor provides a dedicated room for drivers as arranged by the Building Management at any given time, all drivers entering the room must comply with the regulations stated therein;
(h) The Lessor is not liable for any damages, injuries or accidents caused to vehicles parked in the parking area.
The Building Management designated by the Lessor has the right to amend the parking area regulations if deemed necessary after informing the Lessee at least ten (10) days in advance.
The Lessor reserves the right to waive any rules or regulations, pertaining to a particular Lessee, and any waiver shall not be considered a waiver of other rules or regulations or any subsequent application of those rules and regulations to this Lessee.
The Lessor reserves the right to implement other reasonable rules and regulations as deemed appropriate and necessary for the proper and safe operation of the Building, the Building Management as well as the lessees. The Lessor shall provide the Lessee with copies of new or amended rules and regulations before the effective date of such new or amended rules and regulations. The Lessee agrees to comply with these rules and regulations.
